details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue improve?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan / implement issue pipeline workflows
B. Review & autofix workflow (`review_autofix.yml` and its helper scripts)
C. Orchestrator (`orchestrate*.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_*`)
D. Validate workflow / validation harness
E. AI memory subsystem (`scripts/ai_memory.py`, `scripts/memory_helpers.sh`)
F. Documentation only (README / docs)
G. Other. Name the file(s) or workflow in your `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What kind of improvement is wanted?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure. Include the run URL, log excerpt or reproduction steps in your `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
B. Reduce runtime or LLM/API cost
C. Improve reliability (fewer flaky or stalled runs)
D. Add a new feature or behaviour. Describe it in your `/answer`
E. Improve the docs or how clear the logs are
Q3: How will we know the change worked?
Choices:
A. You state a concrete, checkable outcome in your `/answer` (for example, "workflow X no longer fails with error Y" or "phase Z finishes in under N minutes") (RECOMMENDED)
B. New or updated contract tests covering the changed behaviour pass in CI
C. A+B
